name: issue_check
title: Check Issue
description: Check the arguments for issue_write (and the board fields and blocked-by written after it) against the pecot rules before writing: the template of the body, the title prefix and order, the type, the Issue and board fields, the column to place the Issue in, and the prerequisites. A batch create gives the order numbers and how each Issue proceeds. Reads and writes nothing on GitHub; pass the results of the official reads in reads.

method.description: create before issue_write with method create (several Issues for a batch, in the order to write), update before issue_write with method update (one Issue)

project.description: Name of the project config under .pecot/config/projects (without .json). Without it, the config that includes the target repository; when several do, the active one among them

key.description: With a batch create: the name blocked_by and {{issue:key}} of later Issues use for this one

template.description: Template the body follows: pecot-template://issue/<name> for a bundled one (its rules are checked); a replaced template's path or URL is accepted without checking the body; omit for the free form

template_text.description: Text of a replaced template; the body is not checked against it

owner.description: Owner of the repository to write to

repo.description: Name of the repository to write to

issue_number.description: With update only: the Issue to rewrite

body.description: Same as issue_write; without the frontmatter and the guide comment of the template

type.description: Same as issue_write: a GitHub Issue type name

value.description: Value of a text, number or date field

anyOf.description: Value of a text or date field

field_option_name.description: Option name of a single select field

parent_owner.description: Owner of the repository of the parent Epic

parent_repo.description: Name of the repository of the parent Epic

blocked_by.description: With create only: prerequisites to write with issue_dependency_write after the create

issue.description: Prerequisite: owner/repo/N for an existing Issue, or the key of an earlier Issue in the batch

wait.description: stack (build on its branch; the default) or merge (wait until it is merged)

reason.description: With wait merge only: why it waits for the merge, in one line

project_fields.description: Board fields to write with projects_write (update_project_item), including the column (pecot-status)

id.description: Id of the board field (the id in list_project_fields; same as updated_field.id of projects_write)

anyOf.description: Option name, option id or text

value.description: Value as passed to projects_write: an option name or option id for a single select, null to clear

state.description: With update only: same as issue_write

state_reason.description: With update only: same as issue_write

duplicate_of.description: With update only: same as issue_write

issues.description: Arguments of each Issue: the keys of the template, the same values passed to the write tools

reads.description: Results of the official GitHub MCP reads the check needs

issues.description: Results of issue_read with method get (the structuredContent, { issue: ... }): the parent, prerequisites and, with update, the target

sub_issues.description: Results of issue_read with method get_sub_issues for each parent Epic (every page)

parent.description: The parent Epic whose sub-issues were read (owner/repo/N)

result.description: Result of issue_read with method get_sub_issues

project_items.description: Results of projects_list with method list_project_items (every page): the cards of the target, the parent and the prerequisites

project_fields.description: Result of projects_list with method list_project_fields

pull_requests.description: Results of pull_request_read with method get: each open pull request that closes a prerequisite (closed_by_pull_requests of issue_read), and those its base branch stacks on; they decide whether the Issue can stack

issue_fields.description: Result of list_issue_fields for the repository of the Issues

issue_types.description: Result of list_issue_types for the owner of the repository

collaborators.description: Result of list_repository_collaborators for the repository of the Issues

issue.description: Issue the problem belongs to: a batch key or owner/repo/N (omitted when the check covers one target)

field.description: Name of the argument that breaks the rule (title, body, issue_fields.<name>, blocked_by.<i>, ...)

code.description: Kind of the problem (missing-section, extra-heading, cycle, ...)

message.description: What is wrong and how to fix it, with the expected value when there is one

candidates.description: Values that would be accepted (omitted when there is no fixed set)

problems.description: Rules the arguments break; when empty, the arguments can be passed to the write tool as they are

plan.description: With create: how each Issue proceeds, in the order given

key.description: Key of the Issue (issues[i] when it has none)

order.description: Order number in the title (omitted without a parent Epic)

issue.description: Prerequisite: key of an Issue in the batch, or #N / owner/repo#N for an existing Issue

wait.description: How to wait for the prerequisite

stackOn.description: Prerequisite to stack on (only when approach is stack)

stackableChains.description: Stackable chains, each from the bottom; Issues of the batch by key, existing Issues as #N or owner/repo#N (omitted when none)

detail.description: Full failure text: the error message and the guidance lines that follow it (failure only)

log.description: Raw output of a child process (failure only; omitted when not captured)

warnings.description: Warning messages; continuation lines of a message are indented by two spaces (omitted when there is none)
